iti44:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti44:2.3: saupādisesā ca nibbānadhātu anupādisesā ca nibbānadhātu.
iti44:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto.
iti44:3.3: tassa tiṭṭhanteva pañcindriyāni yesaṃ avighātattā manāpāmanāpaṃ paccanubhoti sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
iti44:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto.
iti44:4.3: tassa idheva bhikkhave sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sīti bhavissanti.
iti44:7.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
